outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic combined with western blot images; it is not a plot of averaged quantitative data, so the check does not apply.

Bar charts show %HTT FT depletion and log2 elution abundance per antibody with no error bars, indicating single densitometry measurements per antibody rather than an average across replicates, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a heatmap of normalized protein abundances; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D is a violin plot showing the distribution of enrichment ratios; violin plots already convey the underlying distribution and are exempt.
Bar charts show mean ± SD (n=4) with individual data points overlaid as circles for each antibody/protein.
Panel F shows a sequence alignment and a predicted protein structure, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a scatterplot comparing individual protein enrichment ratios; scatterplots inherently show individual data points and are exempt.
Panel H is a scatterplot of individual IP-MS experiments; scatterplots are exempt from requiring additional individual point overlays.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot where each point already represents an individual sample; scatterplots are exempt.
Panel J is a set of PCA scatterplots where each point already represents an individual sample; scatterplots are exempt.
